policies.name: Cross-border and transaction velocity
policies.text: Review material cross-border transfers that are unusually large relative to a customer's historical transaction average.

policies.name: Unfamiliar customer activity
policies.text: Review transactions from unfamiliar locations and unusual changes in customer payment behavior.

policies.name: Potential transaction structuring
policies.text: Review repeated cash-equivalent or wire transfers below a reporting threshold when their aggregate value is material.

policies.name: Basel III capital adequacy
policies.text: Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio is Common Equity Tier 1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets. The Basel III minimum is 4.5% before applicable buffers.

policies.name: Basel III Tier 1 capital
policies.text: Tier 1 capital ratio is Tier 1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets. The Basel III minimum is 6.0% before applicable buffers.

policies.name: Customer due diligence refresh
policies.text: Refresh customer due diligence based on customer risk classification and review schedule.
